sql: SELECT to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS hora, stage, status, message_id, left(coalesce(payload_summary::text, ''), 220) AS resumo, left(coalesce(error_message, ''), 160) AS erro, latency_ms FROM message_trace_logs WHERE phone LIKE '%996472316%' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-17T15:50:25Z' AND '2026-10-17T15:54:10Z' ORDER BY created_at
